purpose: Current Dungeoneering Remastered systems and reward unlocks not covered by the earlier post-remaster reward overlays. Removed content is stored explicitly so stale reward tables cannot resurrect it.

policy.region_rule: Daemonheim/Dungeoneering is a hard Forinthry dependency in this project.

prayer_additions.name: Rapid Renewal
prayer_additions.effect_summary: While active, natural life-point regeneration occurs five times as quickly.

activity_additions.name: Dungeoneering Remastered floor progression
activity_additions.category: current Daemonheim training and storage state

removed_rewards.name: Scroll of Daemonheim
removed_rewards.reason: The remaster replaced the old Prestige approach and made the Daemonheim XP-trait scroll obsolete.

activity_additions.buff_reset_rule: Buffs cycle in order as unique floors are completed and reset after the player completes the number of floors available to their Dungeoneering level; at level 120 that example is 60 floors. Floor progress resets on the next login.
activity_additions.league_treatment: These are Daemonheim training-state mechanics, not permanent surface-world combat buffs. Keep them out of the global combat ruleset.

equipment_additions.name: Gravite and Chaotic Necromancy weapons
equipment_additions.league_treatment: These form the Forinthry Necromancy weapon ladder below the T90 Ruinous guard/lantern. Keep them separate from the surface Necromancy weapon upgrade path.
